headline: Held security deposit hearings for 106 Birch Court and 73 Buell Street Apt. 1; 54B Intervale Avenue case settled before hearing.
summary: The board held hearings on security deposit disputes for 106 Birch Court and 73 Buell Street Apt. 1, with testimony and evidence presented before each hearing was closed. A third case for 54B Intervale Avenue did not go to hearing because the parties reached a settlement beforehand. The board then deliberated in private.
decisions: The security deposit hearing for 54B Intervale Avenue did not take place because the parties settled beforehand.

decision_evidence.quote: The parties reached a settlement prior to the hearing. The hearing did not take place.
